hero.headline: Stop running your business from notebooks and WhatsApp chats.
hero.sub: I build simple, working websites and apps for business owners: a place to show your products, take orders, and track everything in one place.

services.title: Business websites
services.summary: A clean site that shows who you are and what you sell, so people trust you before they message you.
services.who: Business owners who only have Instagram or WhatsApp today and want to look more serious.
includes: Home, about, products and contact pages
A WhatsApp button so customers reach you fast

services.title: Online store and ordering
services.summary: Customers see your products, pick what they want, and order without a long back-and-forth chat.
services.who: Sellers of food, fashion, farm produce, or anything people order repeatedly.
includes: Product pages with photos and prices
A simple cart and order form
Order details sent to you on WhatsApp

services.title: Order tracking
services.summary: Customers see the status of their order. You update it with one tap.
services.who: Businesses tired of answering “Is my order ready?” all day.
includes: Clear stages: received, preparing, on the way, delivered

services.title: Owner dashboard
services.summary: All your orders, customers, and sales in one simple place.
services.who: Owners who want to stop guessing what is selling and who has paid.
includes: Built to be easy, not complicated

services.title: Mobile apps
services.summary: For businesses ready to put their system on their customers’ phones.
services.who: Businesses with repeat customers who would use an app regularly.
includes: Planning what the app should do

services.title: Design and marketing support
services.summary: Logos, social media graphics, and content, so your business looks good while it runs well.
services.who: Businesses that need a consistent look across their website and social pages.

projects.title: Freelancer CRM
projects.summary: A system that helps freelancers keep track of clients, projects, and payments in one place.
projects.problem: Many freelancers manage clients and payments across chats, notes, and memory, and things get missed.
projects.solution: I built a Freelancer CRM that puts clients, projects, and payments in one organised place.

projects.title: Content Creator OS
projects.summary: A system that helps creators plan, organise, and stay consistent with their content.
projects.problem: Creators often know what to post but struggle to stay organised and consistent.
projects.solution: I built a Content Creator OS that helps creators plan and organise their content in one system.

projects.title: Author Growth HQ
projects.summary: My website and work with first-time and self-published authors, helping them get clear and get seen.
projects.problem: First-time authors often finish a book and then have no clear guidance on publishing and being found.
projects.solution: I built Author Growth HQ as a home for clear, practical author guidance and services.

about.title: Hi, I’m Victor.
about.story:
I help people and businesses grow, whether that’s building systems for business owners, helping authors reach readers, or building communities.

I care about solving real problems in simple ways, not building complicated things nobody uses. If you can explain your problem to me in plain words, I can build something that fixes it.

DOV TECH is where I do that work.
